title: First Complete Failure of the Vulcan Rocket: Initial Cause — Fuel Didn't Reach the Engines! 🚀
body: First Complete Failure of the Vulcan Rocket: Initial Cause — Fuel Didn't Reach the Engines! 🚀

ULA revealed on 18 November the initial cause of the failed Vulcan rocket launch, which was carrying 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites: thrust was weak because fuel did not reach the BE-4 engines in sufficient quantities — the rocket's main engines — not because the engines themselves were faulty.

The rocket lifted off on 15 November and failed about 10 minutes into flight — the first complete mission failure in the joint company's history since its founding in 2006. The US aviation authority has opened an investigation into the incident.
Amazon has 396 satellites in orbit across 14 missions since April 2025, and the next Leo satellite launch will be on an Ariane 6 rocket with 36 satellites, on 23 November at the earliest.
Does this failure affect your trust in satellite internet? 🛰️
